bullets.bullet_text: Led quantitative derivatives, variable-annuity hedging, and insurance-capital engagements, applying exotic pricing, liability Greeks, and higher-order stress testing to design defensible hedge strategies for regulated institutions.

Directed CCAR-era capital, liquidity, and stress-testing engagements, structuring traceable scenarios and challenger models alongside model-risk remediation to produce audit-ready governance evidence for financial institutions.

Architected enterprise risk management operating models aligned to BCBS 239, defining three-lines-of-defense accountability, metadata standards, and auditable risk metrics across regulated organizations.

claim_ledger.claim_text: Led quantitative derivatives, variable-annuity hedging, and insurance-capital work using exotic pricing, liability Greeks, higher-order stress testing, and hedge design.

Led CCAR-era capital, liquidity, stress testing, and model-validation work by structuring traceable scenarios, challenger variants, model-risk remediation, and governance evidence for regulated financial institutions.
Architected ERM operating models and BCBS 239-aligned risk-data aggregation by defining three-lines-of-defense accountability, metadata standards, and auditable risk metrics.
